{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Windswept''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] that was used as a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] by the [[Joruba Consortium]]. Once, while the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] was en route to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]], it was boarded by a group of agents who were working for the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]] [[Malbo]] and [[Tyri]]. The agents attempted to steal some [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinders]] from a group of Consortium troubleshooters who were aboard the corvette.
